title: ID0401322-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / SD 170004182] OperationMode "Close_Mainbreaker" -> "Error"
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
OperationMode "Close_Mainbreaker" -> "Error"
Root cause: QA1 is faulty
Solution: Replace QA1
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:  Siemens Employee
Warranty Status:Active
Charger is OoO. Screen is blinking every 5-10sec when QA29 is trying to close MCCB when MCCB is closed already. Failure in feedback line?
We will continue troubleshooting 22.1.2025. Please forward this to Joao since Francisco is aware of this case but he cannot support 22.1.2025.

additional_info.subject: ID0401322-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / SD 170004182] OperationMode "Close_Mainbreaker" -> "Error" CRM:00315002275
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus, good morning.
I'm taking this over, as we already discussed with R&D:
We were observing iyhMVS,
The issue is not that the KF2 DQ11 is sending the close signal too shortly, but instead the safety relais trips briefly after the QA1 turns on leading to PLC OperationMode Error, and that in turn is stopping the close signal to persist longer.
So the tripped safety relais is causing the other errors you can see in the logs and also causing the converter grouping not happening.
We observed that via tracing the respective signals:
We also applied 24V directly to QA1 C1 and observed the same dip in the safety relais. So it seems that their is some kind of short circuit or other malfunction caused by the QA1.
You will now proceed to replace QA1.
I will this ticket to your queue.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
